name: availability-front
title: The public frontend is unavailable
description: The external frontend health check has reported the service as unhealthy during each of the last three minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the frontend health-check endpoint and confirm whether it responds.
Check the frontend load balancer, target group and ECS service health. Try hitting the frontend directly to see if it responds.
If the service is unavailable, escalate this as soon as possible, an incident will likely need to be raised if this is the case.
